name: A certain autumn evening.
source:
You were here, just minding your own business, appreciating the autumnal scenery on your cozy evening stroll in the park, when you meet a rather...peculiar being.

[From [url=https://qteatime.itch.io/a-certain-autumn-evening]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在这里，只是专注于自己的事情，在公园舒适的夜晚漫步中欣赏秋天的景色，这时你遇到了一个相当……奇怪的存在。

[来自[url=https://qteatime.itch.io/a-certain-autumn-evening]itch.io[/url]]
